concerns.text: Spec FR-002 and Constitution Principle VII require logging 3D conformer generation parameters to `conformer_config.json`. Task T015 (3D generation) is marked [ ] (unimplemented) and T008b (utility) is marked [X] but T015 does not explicitly invoke T008b to produce the required artifact. The Analyze report flags this as a critical missing implementation for FR-002.

Spec FR-004 and US-2 mandate a 'Geometry-Based Baseline' (Oracle) on the held-out test set. Task T021b (Geometry Oracle) is present but marked [ ] (unimplemented). Task T024 is scoped to 'paired t-test' (FR-005) and does not generate the baseline predictions. No task produces the `results/baseline/geometry_oracle_predictions.parquet` artifact required for the comparison in FR-004.

Spec FR-006 and US-3 require a sensitivity analysis sweeping absolute MAE thresholds {0.01, 0.05, 0.1} Å². Task T028 is marked [ ] (unimplemented). The Analyze report indicates this task was previously rejected/missing. Without T028, the mandatory threshold sweep and success rate reporting for FR-006 cannot be executed.

Spec FR-001 requires ingesting SMILES and converting to 2D graph features. Task T048 (Ingestion) and T014 (2D Feature Extraction) are both marked [ ] (unimplemented). The Analyze report flags these as rejected/missing, leaving the entire US-1 data pipeline without a verifiable implementation step.

Task T043 and T044 are marked as '(MOVED TO T048)' and '(MOVED TO T014)' respectively but remain in the task list with checkboxes. These are stale entries that should be removed or marked as completed to avoid confusion, as the logic is now in T048/T014.
